pin.text: Did you know there's a village in Turkey where people talk by whistling?

iceland.text: Hello there! Welcome to Iceland. We have volcanoes, glaciers, hot springs, and a lot of very cold wind.

bolivia.text: Hello, my friend! Welcome to Bolivia. We have mountains, salt flats, and the best empanadas in the world.

russia.text: Hello! Welcome to Russia. We are the biggest country in the world, with eleven time zones and very long winters.

usa.text: Hey there, buddy! Welcome to the United States. We have big cities, big cars, and really, really big burgers.
